still-10s.description: Hand resting still at the centre for 10 s with ~1 px low-pass rest jitter. Expect at most one pen toggle and zero strokes.

calibration.description: Calibration: 3 s resting still (step 1, rest jitter), then a 4 s comfortable clockwise circle (~156x140 camera px, step 2), then 1 s still.

dwell-stroke.description: Still 1.5 s (pen-down dwell fires at ~0.8-1.1 s) -> 2 s left-to-right stroke on screen (130 camera px, ~390 canvas px at 3x) -> still 2.3 s (pen-up dwell at ~1.2 s). Expect exactly 1 stroke.

word-tremor.description: Still 1.5 s -> cursive "hi" (389 camera px over 4.6 s, ~90 px/s) with ~6 Hz +/-5 px tremor during movement (+/-1.5 px at rest) -> still 2.6 s. Expect 1 legible stroke after smoothing.

circle-stroke.description: Still 1.5 s -> roughly circular clockwise closed stroke (r ~52 camera px, ~3 % radius wobble, small closing gap) in 3.2 s -> still 2.3 s. Expect 1 stroke; 'make it a circle' turns it into kind 'circle'.

tracking-lost.description: Still 1.5 s (pen down by dwell) -> stroke in progress for 1.5 s -> 1 s of null frames (no hand) mid-stroke at 3.00 s -> hand back elsewhere, moving for 1 s -> 0.5 s still (too short to re-arm a pen-down dwell). Expect the pen to lift > 300 ms into the loss and stay up after re-acquire.
tracking-lost.expect: pen HOVER from ~lost+0.3 s; tracking 'lost' during gap; pen stays HOVER after; 1 stroke

too-dark.description: Like still-10s but in a dim room: luma 25, noisier rest jitter (~1.5 px) and intermittent null frames (0.2-0.6 s gaps every 0.8-1.6 s). Expect 'too dark' tracking warning.
too-dark.expect: status mentions dark; lossReason 'too-dark' during gaps; 0 strokes
